about_the_game:
The development of Legacy of Datura has ceased on 10 Feb 2026. 

Please refer to the announcements for further details. A Kickstarter backer exclusive update has also been posted on Kickstarter.

short_description: Experience a story-rich Hong Kong-inspired urban fantasy where every frame-perfect parry counts. Master kinetic flow combat and parkour across twin worlds. Join Cyrus in uncovering the secrets of the oppressive Circle.
